chat:event.denied.denied_by_user: Shown on a tool call the user refused in a question card; addresses the user.
chat:event.denied.write_no_path: A file-writing tool call without its path argument. {{tool}}: the tool's name; {{field}}: the argument's name. Both never translated.
chat:event.denied.write_outside_mirror: {{path}}: the file path the agent tried to write, never translated.
chat:event.denied.write_outside_root: {{path}}: the file path the agent tried to write, never translated. "Portuni folder" is PORTUNI_ROOT.
chat:event.error.browser_sign_in_decline: An MCP server wanted the user to sign in in a browser window. {{server}}: the server's name, never translated.
chat:event.error.provider_failed: The runner's provider (Claude Code) ended the run with an error and gave no text. {{subtype}}: the provider's technical error name, never translated.
chat:event.question.mcp_confirmation.tit: Title of a confirmation card an MCP server asked for without a title of its own. {{server}}: the server's name, never translated.
